scripts.cd: bun run cd:build && bun run cd:push && echo '✓ built + pushed both images (latest + git-sha) — pin/rollback via: kubectl -n auto-school set image deploy/auto-school-recorder=ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:$(git rev-parse HEAD)'
scripts.cd:build: TAG=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && docker buildx build --load --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:buildcache --cache-to type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:buildcache,mode=max -t ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:latest -t ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:$TAG -f deploy/Dockerfile . && docker buildx build --load --cache-from type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:buildcache --cache-to type=registry,ref=ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:buildcache,mode=max -t ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:latest -t ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:$TAG -f frontend/Dockerfile .
scripts.cd:push: TAG=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && docker push ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:latest && docker push ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school:$TAG && docker push ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:latest && docker push ghcr.io/lochis/auto-school-frontend:$TAG
